Broadcom (AVGO) vs Advanced Micro Devices (AMD): on the same formula, their operating margins are 29.2 pts apart. What does that gap explain, and what doesn’t it?

Latest fiscal year, same formula
• Revenue — AVGO: $63.9B · AMD: $34.6B
• Revenue growth — AVGO: +23.9% · AMD: +34.3%
• Operating margin — AVGO: 39.9% · AMD: 10.7%
• Net margin — AVGO: 36.2% · AMD: 12.5%
• Free cash flow margin — AVGO: 42.1% · AMD: 19.4%
• 4-year revenue growth (compound annual) — AVGO: 23.5% · AMD: 20.5%

Different fiscal years: AVGO Nov 2, 2025 · AMD Dec 27, 2025. The periods are not identical.
